description: Source code for a plugin that interfaces with Rust plugins, manages plugin lifecycle, dynamic library loading, and communication between C++ and Rust components within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RequestContext
classes.description: Holds context information for a request, including channel ID and authentication token.

classes.name: PluginContext
classes.description: Holds context information for a plugin instance, including ID and a send function.

methods.name: wpe_send_to
methods.description: Extern C function called from Rust to send data to a plugin context.

methods.name: get_library_search_paths
methods.description: Retrieves library search paths from LD_LIBRARY_PATH environment variable.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: find_rust_plugin
methods.description: Attempts to locate and load a Rust plugin shared library from given filename.
